profile_text.body:
Ambarella is a publicly traded company, listed under the ticker AMBA with SEC CIK 0001280263, headquartered in Santa Clara, California. Its own site describes it as a maker of AI vision processors for edge applications, and says its advanced imaging solutions make cameras smarter by extracting data from high-resolution video streams.

The company positions its technology around camera and vehicle applications. Its site names advanced driver assistance systems, smart electronic mirrors, drive recorders, and autonomous vehicles among the uses it addresses, and states that it is committed to preparing customers for the road ahead.

The company's litigation exposure is concentrated in California. No products or MCP servers are tracked for it, and no lawsuits are listed.
